text:
Lauren: Quick ask — building a cost model for the new marketplace SKU bundling. Can partners share (a) committed monthly price per GPU type, (b) typical spot floor and observed avg, and (c) any marketplace credit mechanics (stacking, amortization, expiry)? Need inputs for scenarios (0%, 30%, 60% reserved).

Jason: On it. I'll pull vendor rate cards. heads-up: some partners use transferable credits (swap-for-reserved) which mess with simple amortization.

Mei (CoreVendor): FYI from our side: we offer a 12/24/36 month commit ladder; credits are applied monthly against invoice, expire after 90 days, and cannot be converted to cash. We support 10% burst beyond commit at spot pricing.

Rahul: Important for financial modeling: if credits expire in <6 months we treat as deferred revenue offset vs a true price reduction. please flag expiry lengths.

Sasha: Also ask vendors for minimum commit quantum and any step-down clauses (price reopener after X months). affects curve.

Jason: Quick snapshot I have from two partners (high level):
```
partner, commitment_tenor, reserved_monthly_per_gpu, spot_avg, credit_type, credit_expiry_days
CoreVendor, 12/24/36, $1400/$1250/$1100, $0.45/hr avg, invoice_credit, 90
EdgeCloud, 12/24, $1500/$1320, $0.50/hr avg, marketplace_credit (stackable), 180
```

Mei (CoreVendor): Correct on numbers; note reserved_monthly_per_gpu above is list for A100->H100-like equivalence. For true SKU mapping we'll send detailed SKU file later.

Lauren: This is gold. Can someone ask partners whether credits can be applied to Dedicated commitments (reserved pools) vs only marketplace billing? That changes our internal pass-through model.

Mei (CoreVendor): Credits apply only to marketplace invoices today. Dedicated/EI requires a separate commercial.

infra-bot: capacity-snapshot: marketplace-pool-availability: 72% for next 90d; expected spot volatility +12% in next 30d.

Rahul: For the model, I'll assume: 0% reserved (spot avg), 30% reserved (mix using EdgeCloud numbers), 60% reserved (use CoreVendor 24-month). Will run sensitivity to credit expiry 90 vs 180 days.

Sasha: Also capture vendor SLA credits and penalty offsets — sometimes they give uplift credits if latency SLOs missed, we should not double count those as price reductions.

Lauren: Perfect. Action items: Jason to collect full rate cards + min commit sizes (due EOD Thu), Mei to attach SKU mapping and confirm credit scoping, Rahul to draft three model scenarios and share spreadsheet. I'll consolidate for PM review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
